name: PLANNING COMMISSION
agenda_text:
PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday AUGUST 8, 2019
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Avery
Commissioner French and Smith
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of July 11, 2019
Item 7
8. Public Hearings
8A. Tentative Tract Map 73401 Time Extension No. 1 and Site Plan Review 15-004 Time Extension No. 1
Global Premier Regency Palms Palmdale, LP, Applicant
A request for a time extension to a previous approval to subdivide approximately 6.22 acres into 10 parcels and develop approximately 2.3 acres into an assisted living facility at 38722 Orchid View Place.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution PC-2019-035 approving Tentative Tract Map 73401 Time Extension No. 1 and Site Plan Review 15-004 and find that the project is consistent with the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration.
Justin Sauder, Assistant Planner
8A
8B. Conditional Use Permit 19-010
Canela Trading Inc., Applicant
A request to establish a Type 41 ABC license for a bona fide restaurant (Blue Maki) located at 39409 10th Street West, Suite A.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution PC-2019-034 approving Conditional Use Permit 19-010 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review.
Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
8B
8C. Tentative Tract Map 63008 Time Extension No. 2
The Epic Companies, Applicant
A request to subdivide approximately 10 acres into 41 single-family lots to be located at the southwest corner of Palmdale Boulevard and 70th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution PC-2019-031 approving Tentative Tract Map 63008 Time Extension No. 2 and find that the project is consistent with the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration for the project.
Clarence "Skip" Smith, Assistant Planner
8C
8D. Conditional Use Permit 19-003
Mr. Jose M. Serenil, Applicant
A request to establish a fitness studio (Fit Body Boot Camp) within an existing building located at 40125 10th Street West.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-032 approving Conditional Use Permit 19-003 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review.
Clarence "Skip" Smith, Assistant Planner
8D
8E. Conditional Use Permit 19-008
HHH Invest, Inc., Applicant
A request to establish a Type 41 ABC license for a bona fide restaurant (BurgerIM) to be located at 38713 Tierra Subida Avenue, Suites 215-220.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution PC-2019-033 approving Conditional Use Permit 19-008 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review.
Clarence "Skip" Smith, Assistant Planner
8E
9. Staff Communications
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
11. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, September 12, 2019, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
